title: fix(studio): a customization pair's dashboard or report opens in its base app's edit state
body:
Fixes #37237

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 在 Studio 里打开定制包（某个已安装应用的定制都存在这个配对包里）的仪表盘或报表，之前停在通用条目页，现在直接进基础包应用的编辑状态（仪表盘进编辑、报表进构建器），右上角关闭回到原来的列表。
- 属于「Studio 重构」专题，是上一张「仪表盘和报表在所属应用里打开」改动留下的配对包缺口。
- 出错时作者会落到通用条目页或基础包的另一个应用里，不会改动任何数据；撤回本次改动即恢复原样。
- 无。

## What changes

`StudioAreaAppOpen` (the area's step between a Studio list and an app page) reads the open package's published apps. When the open package is a customization pair (`<base>.custom`, by `customizationPairBaseOf`, the shipped pairing rule) and it has no published app of its own, it now reads the **base's** published apps (one extra read, on the pair leg only, and only for an item open) and runs the same decision-6 rule (`studioAppEditSegment`) over them with the base's id: the remembered app when it is one of the base's (or its menu opens the item), else the base's first app.

- A pair's dashboard opens at `/apps/BASE/dashboard/NAME` in its edit state; a pair's report opens the base app's builder. `?studio=` carries the pair's list, so × returns to it.
- A pair whose base has no published app keeps the generic item page (decision 3).
- A pair that publishes an app of its own opens there, and the base is not read.
- A plain package is unchanged: one app read, as before.
- The item read (does it have a published version?) is still asked of the pair.
- The report list's New (decision 13) is unchanged on the pair leg (see Acceptance notes).

No server, spec or route change. `studioAppEdit.ts` only gains a doc paragraph naming the pair leg.

## Tests

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioAreaAppOpen-36906.test.tsx`, a new top-level `describe` in the shared harness (through the real `StudioMetadataArea` and its routes):

- a pair dashboard opens in the base app's edit state, × returns to the pair's list, the reads are exactly `[app PAIR]`, `[app BASE]`, and the item is read from the pair;
- reached from the base's list: a pair row's `?package=PAIR` link re-roots the area onto the pair and opens the base app;
- a pair report opens the base app's builder, picked by decision 6 among several base apps (remembered app, then first app);
- a pair whose base has no app keeps the generic item page;
- a pair with its own app opens there, with no base read;
- CONTROL: the existing "package with no published app" case now also pins a single app read.

The old pin "a pair row keeps the generic item page" is replaced: that is the behaviour this card changes.

<details><summary>Test run and ablations (4 legs, each red, each restored to HEAD)</summary>

`pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell exec vitest run --root ../.. --maxWorkers=2 …/StudioAreaAppOpen-36906.test.tsx …/studioAppEdit.test.ts` → `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 29 passed (29)`.

`pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` → exit 0.

Ablations via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `StudioAreaAppOpen.tsx` (vitest resolves the source directly; no dist leg):

| leg | mutation | red |
|---|---|---|
| A1 no pair leg | `customizationPairBaseOf(packageId) : null` → `null : null` | 3 failed: pair dashboard, pair report, base-without-app |
| A2 pair id in segment | `packageId: appPackageId, apps` → `packageId, apps` | 1 failed: pair dashboard (`/apps/PAIR/…`) |
| A3 own app ignored | `&& apps.length === 0 ?` → `&& true ?` | 1 failed: pair with its own app |
| A4 CONTROL, leg on any package | `?? 'com.example.hr'` fallback | 1 failed: plain package's single read |

Each leg printed `ok restored: blob == HEAD … git diff HEAD is empty`. A first A3 try missed its anchor (refused, exit 3, nothing ran) and a second was refused for an ambiguous marker; the third run above is the reading.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Reachability (the card's confirmation): the pair-as-scope case is reachable from Studio's menu through a package's list. A pair's row links `./NAME?package=PAIR` (`ResourceListPage` `metadataRowInfo`), and `areaLocationRedirect` re-roots any leg whose `?package=` names another package onto that package, so the area mounts on the pair. The new reach pin drives that redirect. The menu's environment entry (`~all` with `?scope=environment`) keeps rows in the environment scope and does not re-root; the plain `~all` leg does. Confirmed with a pin, not in a browser.
- The report list's New on a pair's own area still uses the area's create. It does not go to the base app's new-report page. The card names opening items only.

## Verification

Two-minute check: run the test file above. Expected: 29 passed. Or in a HotCRM-shaped stack, open Studio → the base package → Dashboards → a row from `.custom`. Expected: the base app's dashboard opens in edit mode, and × lands back on the list.
